messages:
Maya: Heads up — product wants a final SDK/Docs checklist for structured output + function calling before we sign off on GA next sprint. Can we align on minimal surface? :eyes:

Sam: Quick question — keep `structured_output` top-level or move to `response.format`? Customers using both OpenAI- and APIX-style schemas.

Kevin: PM here. We need parity with `function_call` semantics. Launch criteria: stable API, py/ts examples, migration guide, and customer-facing changelog.

Luis: Eng: Runtime already supports both payload shapes, but SDK surface needs to pick a canonical representation. I prefer `response.format` so we can support `json_schema | xml | custom` later.

Olivia: Proposed GA checklist:
- API contract locked for 2 weeks
- Type defs in TS + Python examples (pydantic/dataclasses)
- Migration guide + quickstart
- Changelog + deprecation notes
- E2E smoke tests + perf baseline
- Telemetry: `schema_version` on responses

Sam: SDK tasks (proposal):
1) TS types + two examples (chat + function calling)
2) Python dataclass + pydantic validator example
3) Compat shim exposing `legacy_structured_output` flag
ETA: 2 sprints? :calendar:

Maya: Docs team take migration guide and quickstart? @docs-bot please spin up draft and link.

docs-bot: Draft created: /docs/drafts/structured-output-migration.md — PR wip, assigned to docs-team.

Kevin: Customer ask: default should be backward compatible. If we opt for `response.format`, include a server-side compatibility toggle for existing requests.

Luis: We can add `compat_mode: boolean = true` server-side and expose in SDKs. Will add unit + integration tests.

Sam: Example TS interface I'll start:
```ts
export interface StructuredResponse<T> {
  schema_version: string;
  format: 'json_schema' | 'custom';
  payload: T;
}
```
And Python snippet:
```py
@dataclass
class StructuredResponse:
    schema_version: str
    format: str
    payload: dict
```

Olivia: Also need rollout plan: canary for 48h, monitor errors and schema validation failures, auto-rollback if >0.5% errors.

Maya: Action items:
- Sam: PR for TS types + examples (due in 10 business days)
- Luis: runtime compat flag + tests (due in 2 weeks)
- Docs: migration guide + quickstart (first draft in 4 days)
- Olivia: define canary metrics and smoke test

Sam: Sounds good. I'll open the initial PR tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Luis: I'll add tests and a feature flag. Keep me looped on exact prop names.

Maya: Thanks everyone — will synthesize into a short roadmap doc after this thread. Ping me for clarifications.
